verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party documentation of event-triggered rules in DBOS. What it does document is adjacent: cron schedules are time-based recurring triggers rather than event rules, and DBOS.send/recv only signals workflows that are already running, which is a developer primitive. The Kafka pipeline was a customer building their own event processing with DBOS, not a documented trigger capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
